name: AADCO Medical, Inc.
old_description: As an Original Equipment Manufacturer, AADCO Medical expends significant resources on product development. Whether it be our newest innovative, original, and patented products, or subtle enhancements in the quality and usability of all-time customer favorites.
about:
AADCO Medical, Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Randolph, Vermont. The company operates its design, engineering, manufacturing, and distribution facilities from Catamount Commercial Park in Randolph.

As an original equipment manufacturer, AADCO develops and produces medical imaging equipment and radiology protection products. Its product line includes the ErgoLite® radiation protection apron, Hercules® and MRI-Safe® overhead suspension systems, mobile barriers, mobile lighting, lead gloves, and protective eyewear. All products are manufactured at the company's Vermont facility.

The company serves hospitals, radiology labs, and interventional radiologists across the United States and internationally through its affiliate AADCO Medical, Asia-Pacific, Ltd. in Hong Kong. Customers include professionals such as Dr. Douglas Coldwell, an interventional radiologist who has endorsed the ErgoLite® apron for reducing back strain during long procedures.

AADCO emphasizes a quality management system certified to ISO 13485:2016, along with UL, CE, and CB certifications. The company highlights its U.S.-based manufacturing, a dedicated team of long-term employees, and lean processes that it says allow faster, more affordable delivery than larger competitors. Warranties extend beyond industry standards, including a lifetime warranty on radiation protection aprons and a 10-year warranty on Hercules® suspension systems.

name: AB Electronics
old_description: Since 1994, Innovative Electronics has been a leading partner in providing cutting-edge mechanical and electrical assembly solutions across diverse applications and industries. Our team excels in supporting your projects through every stage, from product development and design to contract manufacturing and sustaining services.
about:
AB Electronics was founded in 1994 in Danbury, Connecticut. The company operates as part of the Aragra Technologies group, which extends its manufacturing and distribution capabilities across a broader network.

The shop provides full-service electronics contract manufacturing, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly (with BGA capability), cable and harness assembly, electro-mechanical box builds, flexible circuit integration, conformal coating, potting, and functional testing. It also offers product development, design assistance, new product introduction, and sustaining services such as supply chain management, inventory control, and lifecycle support. The company describes its capacity as low-to-high volume, noting cable and harness orders ranging from ten pieces to over one thousand.

Its customer base spans industrial, military, rail, medical, automotive, and other highly regulated sectors. Clients range from original equipment manufacturers needing turnkey assembly to firms requiring design-for-manufacturability reviews and long-term sustaining engineering.

AB Electronics positions itself as an extension of its clients' teams, emphasizing transparent communication, continual investment in modern equipment and skilled personnel, and a regional manufacturing footprint with global reach. The stated purpose is to support American innovation by providing the capacity and resources to bring product designs to market.

name: AC Horn Manufacturing
old_description: Originally a small sheet metal business founded in 1907, AC Horn has developed into a leading global supplier of food processing equipment. PROBAT's investment in this acquisition not only complements its existing products and services, particularly for nut and snack processing, but also increases the efficiency of its own production processes through greater vertical integration. Furthermore, AC Horn and PROBAT share an unrivalled commitment to their customers that sets both companies apart in their respective industries.
about:
AC Horn Manufacturing traces its roots to a modest garage in Dallas, Texas, where the company was founded in 1907 as a small sheet metal operation. The business took its modern shape in 1946 when A.C. 'Ace' Horn assumed leadership of his father's enterprise, establishing a philosophy built on integrity and keeping one's word. The company remains family-owned, with Michael Horn serving as president and CEO until its acquisition by Germany's PROBAT Group in February 2024.

Today, Horn designs and builds processing equipment for the snack food industry, including popcorn cookers and coaters, continuous and batch nut roasters, peanut blanchers, nut butter mills, corn masa mills for tortillas and chips, and pellet puffing systems. The product line also features the modular M360 platform that allows customers to scale automation as production grows. A job shop division provides custom fabrication services. The Dallas facility employs approximately 1,000 people, though exact floor space and annual output figures are not publicly disclosed.

Horn serves snack food manufacturers of all sizes, from smaller regional processors to global corporations. Its equipment is used for popcorn, roasted and coated nuts, Japanese-style peanuts, nut butters, corn-based snacks, and puffed pellets. The company's customer base spans the broader food processing sector, with particular depth in nut and snack applications.

The company attributes its differentiation to a century-old commitment to craftsmanship — using high-quality components, thoughtful design, and no shortcuts — backed by an unrivaled service pledge to fix issues quickly and provide ongoing technical support. The 2024 acquisition by PROBAT, another family-owned firm, was framed as a cultural fit that would strengthen both organizations through vertical integration and shared expertise.

name: ACE Solar
old_description: ACE Solar was founded in 2015 and has been focused on the opportunity to build cleaner energy solutions. We began this journey in residential and commercial installations progressing to utility-scale projects over time, that’s why we’re Born from Experience. We are an independent EPC solar contractor providing full-service solar energy solutions including engineering, solar site design, procurement, pre-construction, construction, and operational management of solar energy assets.
about:
ACE Solar was founded in 2015 in North Andover, Massachusetts. The company began with residential and commercial solar installations before expanding into utility-scale projects, operating as an independent engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contractor for solar energy systems. No founders are named in the source material, and ownership structure is not specified.

The firm provides full-lifecycle solar services: engineering, site design, procurement, pre-construction, construction, and operational management. It also installs energy storage systems and offers operations and maintenance (O&M) for both commercial and residential arrays. Since 2017, ACE Solar has completed more than 552 megawatts of solar installations and over 92 megawatt-hours of battery storage. The company operates from its North Andover headquarters and additional offices in North Oxford, MA; Biddeford, ME; Atkinson, NH; Silver Springs, MD; and New York City, NY.

ACE Solar serves commercial, industrial, government, and utility-scale clients across New England and beyond. Project types include rooftop arrays for small businesses, school installations, parking garage canopies, landfill redevelopment, and ground-mount solar farms. The company also provides maintenance services for existing residential and commercial systems.

The company emphasizes its in-house team of construction, electrical, and engineering professionals, combined with established industry connections and decades of experience. It positions itself as a single-provider EPC solution, offering transparent pricing, customer satisfaction, and ongoing maintenance to keep systems in optimal condition. The "Born from Experience" tagline reflects its progression from residential roots to large-scale project execution.

name: ACS Industries Inc
old_description: ACS is the world’s preeminent manufacturer of pyrotechnic airbag inflator filters coolants, and cushions. We are the only company to offer all the preferred filter media of knitted wire mesh, woven wire mesh, micro expanded metal, and sintered wound-wire.
about:
ACS Industries Inc was founded in 1941 in Lincoln, Rhode Island. The company remains headquartered there and operates as a vertically integrated wire mesh manufacturer.

The company produces a range of critical components including pyrotechnic airbag inflator filters, coolants, cushions, automotive exhaust components, and safety components. Its manufacturing capabilities span woven metal mesh, expanded metal, knitted wire mesh, wire cloth, sintering and brazing, crimping, wire drawing, annealing, stamping, and part assembly. ACS operates over 1,000,000 square feet of manufacturing space across facilities in Rhode Island, Texas, Romania, Mexico, China, India, and Germany, supported by a state‑of‑the‑art R&D center in Rhode Island.

ACS serves automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, delivering hundreds of millions of airbag inflator filters annually. It also supplies the green energy sector with components for PEM and alkaline electrolyzers, and provides products for insulation and cleaning‑supply applications. Long‑term partnerships with major automotive manufacturers underscore its position in safety‑critical supply chains.

ACS differentiates itself as the only supplier offering all four preferred filter media — knitted wire mesh, woven wire mesh, micro expanded metal, and sintered wound‑wire. Proprietary technologies such as Variable Expanded Metal (V.E.M.) and MicroExpan metal expanding, along with a 3D knitting process for electrolyzer components, enable tight‑tolerance, low‑waste production. The company emphasizes early engineering engagement and rapid prototyping to move projects from concept to mass production.

name: ALL COUNTY SHEET METAL INC
old_description: All County Sheet Metal has been serving customers in South Florida since 1982.  Our shop is located close to I-95 at Exit 64, 10th Avenue North in Lake Worth. We are a Lake Worth sheet metal company, but we service customers all over South Florida.
about:
All County Sheet Metal was founded in 1982 in Lake Worth Beach, Florida, and has operated from a shop near I-95 at Exit 64 on 10th Avenue North. The company serves customers throughout South Florida, including West Palm Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, and Fort Lauderdale.

The shop produces both standard and custom sheet metal products, with a focus on HVAC components such as auxiliary drain pans, ductwork, and roofing fixtures, as well as curbs and doghouse covers. Processes include MIG (GMAW) welding, spot welding, hot iron and torch soldering, and plasma cutting on a Vulcan system with supporting software. Manual layout and design assistance from a network of professional mechanical and structural engineers are also available. Jobs range in value from $45 to over $10,000, and the company maintains a production line for stock items that are available for immediate pickup.

Primary customers are HVAC contractors, but the company also supports plumbers, roofers, property managers, electricians, and individual homeowners. Its accounts span from individual buyers to Fortune 500 companies, and the shop emphasizes that no job is too small.

All County Sheet Metal states its goal is to deliver quality products and service in a timely manner. The presence of a full-time welder, bilingual office staff, and membership in the Palm Beach Air Conditioning Contractors Association (PBACCA) are cited as factors that help meet that goal.

name: AMBAC International
old_description: AMBAC specializes in machining, grinding, and honing to the highest tolerances for low to medium volume projects. Serving aerospace, defense, and industrial OEMs, we deliver precision and reliability for the components that matter most.
about:
AMBAC International, based in Elgin, South Carolina, traces its roots to 1910 when it began as American Bosch, manufacturing heavy-duty engine components in the United States. The company is employee-owned, operating under an open-book leadership model that shares financial transparency with its workforce.

The company specializes in precision machining, grinding, and honing, holding micron-level tolerances for low- to medium-volume production. Its services span manufacturing and remanufacturing of complex mechanical assemblies, including reverse engineering, product design, heat treatment, and assembly with test. Production volumes range from 100 to 50,000 estimated annual units, with a work envelope of 0.25 to 18 inches and diameters up to approximately 6 inches.

AMBAC serves aerospace, defense, and industrial original equipment manufacturers, as well as remanufacturing distributors. Its core focus is power and fluid components such as camshafts, valves, pumps, and injectors for high-pressure fluid flow and powertrain applications.

The firm differentiates itself through its century-long legacy, employee ownership culture, and relationship-based approach that emphasizes personalized service and technical depth in engineering and metallurgy.

name: AMERICAN AUTOMOTIVE LLC
old_description: Our quality flooring products have been the industry go-to since 2017 for outstanding and long-lasting performance. Offering five different systems, we bring a variety of durable concrete, versatile epoxies, and coats to repair and protect against all elements.
about:
American Automotive LLC operates as a Rhino Linings applicator in Livingston, Montana. The location at 320 1/ provides professionally installed spray-on protective coatings for vehicles and equipment. While the Rhino Linings brand was established in 1988, the founding date of this independently owned applicator is not publicly disclosed.

The shop applies Rhino Linings' multi-component polyurea and polyurethane formulas to truck beds, marine surfaces, trailer floors, and a range of commercial, industrial, and military equipment. The process includes deep cleaning, masking, mechanical scuffing with a multi-speed polisher, compressed-air dust removal, and spray application that develops a textured finish. Installations typically take up to three hours, with same-day vehicle return and a 24-hour cure before heavy use. The facility uses Graco and PMC proportioning equipment and stocks genuine replacement parts.

Customers include individual truck owners, fleet operators, construction companies, emergency-vehicle upfitters, marine dealers, and military maintenance units. The applicator serves the automotive, marine, commercial, industrial, and defense sectors across the region, coating everything from ATVs and RVs to heavy construction machinery and tactical vehicles.

The location differentiates itself through the Rhino Linings Nationwide Limited Lifetime Warranty on bed liners, color-matching and custom-color capabilities, and a technician-trained installation process that the company says ensures permanent adhesion and resistance to cracking, peeling, and extreme temperatures from -40 °F to 190 °F.

about:
AMP Welding & Metal Fabrication is a privately owned welding and fabrication company founded in 2018 in Daphne, Alabama. The business was started by Alvon Portis, who brought over 20 years of experience in the commercial and residential building industries into a full‑time steel, aluminum, and metallurgical production operation. Today the shop manages projects across Alabama, Mississippi, and parts of Florida.

The company operates as a custom production metal shop, offering a wide range of welding processes — including MIG, TIG, stick, laser, orbital, flux‑core, and specialized techniques for stainless steel, cast iron, pipeline, and underwater applications — alongside fabrication services such as metal fabrication, stainless steel fabrication, industrial and heavy metal fabrication, staircase and handrail fabrication, plasma cutting, and powder coating. A core workforce of skilled engineers, operatives, and technicians handles projects from initial blueprints through final installation, though the facility size and exact headcount are not disclosed.

AMP serves commercial, residential, military, aerospace, medical, industrial, automotive, electronics, agricultural, and entertainment sectors. Its customer base includes businesses, homeowners, and clients seeking art projects or specialty designs, with the company emphasizing hands‑on collaboration from concept to completion.

The firm highlights its commitment to safety, timely delivery, innovative technology, customer‑focused solutions, long‑term durability, full project support, eco‑friendly practices, and transparent pricing as key differentiators. Portis’s artistic background is also noted as a driver for turning client concepts into finished metalwork.
